mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT C_IDX) FROM COMPANY WHERE C_STATUS = 'NORMAL'
AND ( C_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )
SELECT C_IDX, C_NAME, C_NICNAME, C_LOGO, C_INDUSTRY, C_EST, C_INTRO, C_NUMBER, C_BUSINESS, C_REGISTER, C_UPDATE, C_STATUS, C_CR_IDX FROM COMPANY WHERE C_IDX = #{c_idx}

SELECT REW.R_IDX AS R_IDX, REW.R_C_IDX AS R_C_IDX, REW.R_U_IDX AS R_U_IDX, REW.R_STAR AS R_STAR, REW.R_TITLE AS R_TITLE, REW.R_CONTENT AS R_CONTENT, REW.R_DATE AS R_DATE, CASE WHEN REW.R_WORK = 'CURRENT' THEN '현직원' WHEN REW.R_WORK = 'FORMER' THEN '전직원' END AS R_WORK, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, COP.C_NICNAME AS C_NICNAME FROM REVIEW AS REW INNER JOIN USER AS USR ON REW.R_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX INNER JOIN COMPANY AS COP ON COP.C_IDX = USR.U_C_IDX WHERE R_C_IDX = #{r_c_idx} LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMPANY_REQUEST ( CR_U_IDX, CR_NAME, CR_INTRO, CR_BUSINESS, CR_LOGO, CR_EST) VALUES ( #{cr_u_idx}, #{cr_name}, #{cr_intro}, #{cr_business}, #{cr_logo}, #{cr_est} )
mapper.select: SELECT COP.C_IDX, COP.C_NAME, COP.C_NICNAME, COP.C_LOGO, COP.C_INDUSTRY, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(REW.R_STAR)/COUNT(REW.R_STAR),1),0) AS STAR, COUNT(REW.R_IDX) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM COMPANY COP JOIN REVIEW REW ON COP.C_IDX = REW.R_C_IDX WHERE COP.C_STATUS = 'NORMAL' GROUP BY COP.C_IDX HAVING REVIEW_COUNT >= 1 ORDER BY STAR DESC, REVIEW_COUNT DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COP.C_IDX, COP.C_NAME, COP.C_LOGO, COP.C_INDUSTRY, COP.C_EST, COP.C_INTRO, COP.C_NUMBER, COP.C_BUSINESS, COP.C_REGISTER FROM COMPANY COP WHERE COP.C_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{c_name}, '%') AND COP.C_STATUS = 'NORMAL' ORDER BY C_REGISTER DESC
